title: Request API access
intro: The Saisonmanager API provides leagues, schedules, results, tables and statistics. If you want to build something for floorball with it, you can request access here.

intent.heading: Is your project commercial?
intent.hint: Commercial means: selling or passing on the data, paid offerings and paywalls, or ad funding that earns a profit beyond covering running costs.
intent.nonCommercialHint: For example a club website, a widget, a statistics tool, research or open source.
intent.commercialHint: The application process in the system does not cover this, it needs an individual arrangement.

commercialNotice.heading: Commercial projects are arranged individually
commercialNotice.text: The terms of use exclude commercial exploitation, so the application ends here. Instead, drop us a short note about your plans and we will look at your case.
commercialNotice.include2: what the offering does and for whom
commercialNotice.include4: which data you need and how often

summary.heading: The essentials at a glance
summary.item1: No commercial exploitation: no selling the data, no paywall, no ad funding for profit (§ 4.1).
summary.item2: No applications that replicate core Saisonmanager functions, meaning competition management, licensing or transfers (§ 4.2).
summary.item3: Data is delivered with a ten-minute delay; there is no real-time access (§ 6.3).
summary.item4: The access is capped at {{limit}} requests per minute: cache sensibly, do not mirror the full dataset without prior arrangement (§ 6.1, § 6.2).
summary.item5: Credit the source (“Daten: Saisonmanager / Floorball Verband Deutschland e. V.”) and mark your own offering as unofficial (§ 7).
summary.item6: Do not publish contact details of players, referees or officials, do not build personal profiles, and treat data on minors with particular care (§ 5).
summary.item7: One key per project, never shared: you are liable for every request made with it (§ 2.3).
summary.item8: Provided as is, and access can be revoked at any time (§ 9, § 11).
summary.footnote: This summary does not replace the agreement. Only the full text is binding.

form.acceptTerms: I have read the terms of use and accept them.
form.submitHint: Please fill in the required fields and confirm the agreement.

form.genericError: The request could not be submitted. Please try again later.
form.doneText: We have received your request and will review it. You will hear from us by email at the address you provided.

terms.languageNotice: This agreement is legally binding in German only. If you need help understanding it, please contact it@floorball.de.

reveal.title: Collect your API key
reveal.onceHint: The key is shown exactly once and cannot be retrieved afterwards, not even by us. Have somewhere ready to store it.
reveal.onceWarning: Store the key now. It will not be shown again.
reveal.nextStep1: Send the key as an X-Api-Key header with every request.
reveal.rateLimit: The access is capped at {{limit}} requests per minute. Beyond that the API responds with status 429 and states the wait in seconds in the Retry-After header.
reveal.nextStep2: The endpoint documentation is at doku.saisonmanager.org.
reveal.nextStep3: Get in touch if the key is lost or if you are planning a second project.
reveal.alreadyRevealed: The key has already been collected through this link. For security reasons we only store its check value, so we cannot show it again. Contact it@floorball.de if you need new access.
reveal.expired: This link has expired. Contact it@floorball.de and we will issue a new one.
